name.quote: "Board" means the state board of technical registration.

type.quote: Each member who is an architect, a geologist, a landscape architect, a professional engineer or a land surveyor shall have at least five years' active professional experience as attested by registration under this chapter.

degree_required.value: Graduate of a school approved by the board or five years or more of education or experience in architectural work
degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more, or if an applicant for in-training registration as an architect, five years or more, of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession in which registration is sought that meets standards specified by the board in its rules.

degree_level.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more, or if an applicant for in-training registration as an architect, five years or more, of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession in which registration is sought that meets standards specified by the board in its rules.

school_approval_basis.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more, or if an applicant for in-training registration as an architect, five years or more, of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession in which registration is sought that meets standards specified by the board in its rules.

required.quote: An applicant for professional registration as an architect, engineer, geologist or landscape architect shall: 1. Be actively engaged in education or experience, or both, in the profession for which registration is sought for at least eight years.

experience_source.quote: Be actively engaged in education or experience, or both, in the profession for which registration is sought for at least eight years.

duration.value: at least eight years (combined education and experience)
duration.quote: Be actively engaged in education or experience, or both, in the profession for which registration is sought for at least eight years.

kind.value: active engagement in education or experience in architecture, under direct supervision of a registered professional
kind.quote: experience credited by the board under this section and sections 32-101, 32-122 and 32-126 must be attained under the direct supervision of a professional who is satisfactory to the board and registered in this state, another state or a foreign country in the profession in which the applicant is seeking registration

exams.name: In-training examination (architecture)
exams.notes: Required unless exempt under section 32-126, subsection D.
exams.quote: Unless exempt under section 32-126, subsection D, pass the in-training examination in the profession in which registration is sought.

exams.name: Professional registration examination (architecture)
exams.quote: Unless exempt under section 32-126, pass the applicable in-training and professional examinations in the profession in which registration is sought.

interval_years.quote: a new application shall be filed each year by the firm within thirty days of the anniversary date of the original firm registration.

required.quote: The board may require evidence it deems necessary to establish the continuing competency of registrants as a condition of renewal of licenses.

available.quote: An applicant for professional registration as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect in this state through reciprocity or endorsement shall hold both of the following: 1. A valid license, registration or certification issued by the proper authority of either: (a) Another state, territory, district or possession. (b) A country participating in the applicable profession's national council mutual recognition agreement. 2. A certification or model law designation from the applicable profession's national council.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license/registration from another state, territory, district, possession, or participating country, plus a certification or model law designation from the applicable profession's national council.
requirements.quote: An applicant for professional registration as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect in this state through reciprocity or endorsement shall hold both of the following: 1. (b) A country participating in the applicable profession's national council mutual recognition agreement. 2. exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of technical registration.

regulatory_model.quote: a person or firm desiring to practice any board-regulated profession or occupation shall first secure a certificate or registration and shall comply with all the conditions prescribed in this chapter

credential_type.quote: "Architect" means a person who, by reason of knowledge of the mathematical and physical sciences and the principles of architecture and architectural engineering acquired by professional education and practical experience, is qualified to engage in the practice of architecture and is registered as an architect pursuant to this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: a person or firm desiring to practice any board-regulated profession or occupation shall first secure a certificate or registration and shall comply with all the conditions prescribed in this chapter

title_protection.quote: Practices, offers to practice or by any implication holds himself out as qualified to practice any board regulated profession or occupation if the person is not registered or certified as provided by this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: Practices, offers to practice or by any implication holds himself out as qualified to practice any board regulated profession or occupation if the person is not registered or certified as provided by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a certificate of qualification, whether in the application or qualification examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a certificate of qualification, whether in the application or qualification examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetence, bribery or other misconduct in the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence, incompetence, bribery or other misconduct in the practice of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unregistered or uncertified person to evade this chapter or conspiring with or allowing one's registration to be used by an unregistered person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unregistered or uncertified person to evade this chapter or knowingly combining or conspiring with an unregistered or uncertified person, or allowing one's registration or certification to be used by an unregistered or uncertified person or acting as agent, partner, associate or otherwise of an unregistered or uncertified person, with intent to evade this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of this chapter or board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of this chapter or board rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay a collaborating registered professional within seven calendar days after the registrant receives payment from a client, unless otherwise contractually specified.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay a collaborating registered professional within seven calendar days after the registrant receives payment from a client unless specified otherwise contractually between the prime professional and the collaborating registered professional.

definition_quote.value: "Architectural practice" means any professional service or creative work requiring architectural education, training and experience, and the application of the mathematical and physical sciences and the principles of architecture and architectural engineering to such professional services or creative work as consultation, evaluation, design and review of construction for conformance with contract documents and design, in connection with any building, planning or site development.
definition_quote.quote: "Architectural practice" means any professional service or creative work requiring architectural education, training and experience, and the application of the mathematical and physical sciences and the principles of architecture and architectural engineering to such professional services or creative work as consultation, evaluation, design and review of construction for conformance with contract documents and design, in connection with any building, planning or site development.

value: review of construction for conformance with contract documents and design
methods_authorized.quote: consultation, evaluation, design and review of construction for conformance with contract documents and design, in connection with any building, planning or site development

permitted_firm_structures.quote: "Firm" means any individual or partnership, corporation or other type of association, including the association of a nonregistrant and a registrant who offers to the public professional services regulated by the board.

seal_required.quote: Plans, specifications, plats or reports prepared by a registrant or a registrant's bona fide employee shall be issued under the registrant's seal if the board requires the registrant to use a seal.

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: It is unlawful for a registrant whose certificate has expired or has been revoked or suspended to use the seal.

value: individual unit in a multifamily dwelling (non-bearing, non-shear, non-firewall walls)
one or two story building not exceeding 3,000 sq ft, not occupied by more than 20 persons, max 20-foot structural span
additions or alterations to one or two story buildings within the 3,000 sq ft limit (with specified exceptions)
water or wastewater treatment plant designs with total construction cost not exceeding $12,500
buildings/structures on property owned or leased by the designing nonregistrant, not for public use
exempt_building_types.quote: A nonregistrant who designs, alters or adds to either of the following: (a) A detached single-family dwelling. (b) An individual unit in a multifamily dwelling if the walls that are designed, altered or added in the unit are not bearing walls, shear walls or firewalls

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: Any person who commits any of the following acts is guilty of a class 2 misdemeanor: 1. Practices, offers to practice or by any implication holds himself out as qualified to practice any board regulated profession or occupation if the person is not registered or certified as provided by this chapter.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: it, in addition to any other sanction, action or remedy, shall issue an order that imposes a civil penalty of no more than two thousand dollars per violation.
